values: T3+ weapon specializations are exclusive within Weapons and armor; the character research budget is 48 points.
Workshop 0 means hand crafting. All guns require character level 2 AND tier 2 exploration, including looted guns.
Recipe tier controls exploration, workshop, Crafting level and research gates. All material columns show the cost for one weapon.
No recipe currently exists for Trail rifle (ID 1); it is available in the Broodheart and Iron Mourner Soulbound pools.
The current basic enemy gun drop pool is IDs 2–5 at matching tiers. Other special encounters may grant additional equipment.

Iron Mourner weapon pool: Trail rifle, Woodland rifle, Industrial carbine, Precision rifle, Experimental rifle, Scrap shotgun, Crossbow, Iron spear, Sledgehammer, Alloy longsword, Stormfire chain sword, Hunting knife.
Broodheart first-completion Soulbound pool: Trail rifle, Woodland rifle, Industrial carbine, Precision rifle, Experimental rifle, Scrap shotgun.
Iron Mourner also grants 1 weapon upgrade, with a 20% chance of a second. Individual upgrades roll 15–30% power.
Upgrade kinds: Penetrator core (armor), Gyro stabilizer (recoil), Quickdraw limbs (bow draw), Efficient drive (fuel saving), Balanced grip (melee stamina). One active at a time.
New boss items are tradable only within the original kill group. Trade from Soulbound armory within 6m; recipient accepts. Old items remain bound.

Quality upgrades set a quality floor, rather than adding to each other: barrel lapping 10%, action bedding 15%, precision calibration 20%, Foreman tempering 20%, nocturnal tuning 25%, legendary ascension 50%.
Legendary ascension: workshop 5, 1 heart, 6 alloy, 6 electronics, 8 bioalloy. Maximum-tier eligibility is T4 for bows/sledgehammer and T5 for other classes.
Stormfire Q: 20 stamina + 8 fuel + 4 cells; 10s cooldown; 1.4s flame burst with 5.5m reach. Electric contact is additional to listed weapon damage.
Sources: game/Scripts/Logic/ExpeditionSoulbound.cs; ExpeditionMegaLoot.cs; ExpeditionCampaign.cs; ExpeditionCraftingRules.cs; ExpeditionBossTrading.cs; game/Scripts/ExpeditionChainSword.cs.

Choose a harvesting tool in K > Hunting before pressing F beside the carcass. Harvesting takes 3 seconds.
One tool applies to the whole carcass. Half units accumulate across hunts; changing tool mid-harvest cannot combine both bonuses.
Shovel/earthwork and builder hammer also exist as contextual utilities; they have no standalone combat weapon entry or weapon damage stats.
